title: wpa_211_requests
description: REAL 2-1-1 helpline requests across the 25 Western Pennsylvania counties served by the United Way of Southwestern Pennsylvania, one row per request: the WPRDC resource verbatim, all 13 columns, the upstream resource entire (2023-09-22 .. 2025-08-27, no window and no sample - see gen_wpa_211_requests.py). Used to demonstrate a denominator-aware region map on a real service log rather than a synthetic one. No population column is carried on purpose: the rate panel's denominator is FETCHED by --denominator census@2024, and the county boundaries by --geojson auto, which also canonicalizes the county NAMES below to Census GEOIDs so the fetched population keys onto them.

_id.title: Row ID
_id.description: The WPRDC datastore's row number for the request.

contact_date.title: Contact Date
contact_date.description: Date the request reached the 2-1-1 helpline.

gender.title: Gender
gender.description: Self-reported gender of the caller, where recorded.

age_range.title: Age Range
age_range.description: Banded age of the caller, where recorded.

zip_code.title: ZIP Code
zip_code.description: The ZIP code the request came from. Deliberately not tagged as a geography: county is the one region this schematic maps, and a second geo concept would compete with it for the choropleth.

county.title: County
county.description: County of the caller, as the portal spells it ("Allegheny", without "County"). The ONLY region concept in this dictionary, deliberately: tagging zip_code geo.* as well would create a competing choropleth candidate. --geojson auto resolves these names to Census GEOIDs, qualified by state.

state.title: State
state.description: Pennsylvania on every row that has a state; 65 rows have none. Tagged geo.state so --geojson auto qualifies each county name by it (Erie, Crawford and Westmoreland are also county names in other states).

needs_category.title: Need Category
needs_category.description: The specific need the caller asked about.

taxonomy_name.title: Taxonomy Name
taxonomy_name.description: The 2-1-1 taxonomy term the request was coded to.

needs_code.title: Taxonomy Code
needs_code.description: The 2-1-1 taxonomy code for Taxonomy Name.

level_1_classification.title: Need Group
level_1_classification.description: Top level of the AIRS/211 taxonomy for the need behind the request - Basic Needs, Income Support and Employment, and so on. The finer levels are level_2_classification (69 values), needs_category (973) and taxonomy_name (1,037).

level_2_classification.title: Need Subgroup
level_2_classification.description: The need's second-level classification, within Need Group.

needs_met.title: Need Met
needs_met.description: Whether the Resource Navigator could connect the caller to a service for this need. 't' or 'f'.
